rationale_short: Continued-pretraining on unlabeled domain text with token NLL; no judge, no external verifier.
Minimal-recipe domain continued pretraining that needs no human curation beyond raw text.
Language-adaptation CPT showing emergent abilities arise from token-NLL on target-language corpora alone.
CPT with a small replay buffer to close the early stability gap; signal is still token NLL.
CPT recipe that aligns replay gradients with new-domain gradients; supervision is token NLL only.
Long-context CPT via segment-and-summarize objective; gradient is sequence likelihood on engineered corpus.
128K-context CPT by upsampling long documents; pure NLL on a re-balanced unlabeled mix.
Long-context CPT recipe across 32K–128K; positional-embedding tweaks plus standard token NLL.
Test-time learning treats the test stream itself as a CPT corpus; gradient is sequence NLL.
Test-time training on a retrieved neighborhood of the query; gradient is local-NLL only.
Long-context TTT that adapts within a single long prompt via local NLL.
In-place TTT interleaves NLL updates with generation, persisting state across chunks of one sequence.
Entropy minimization on unlabeled prompts; the model's own per-token entropy is the loss or PG reward.
Single-prompt entropy minimization; gradient is the entropy of one rollout, no labels needed.
Entropy minimization on unlabeled prompts; the model's own per-token entropy is the loss or PG reward.
Entropy minimization on unlabeled prompts; the model's own per-token entropy is the loss or PG reward.
Self-confidence reward (negative entropy) used as the PG signal; no answer key.
Reward learning from self-confidence on unlabeled prompts; PG against own probability mass.
Per-prompt optimization vector trained at test time via NLL; sample-local state, no judge.
Test-time LoRA fitted from 4 extra unlabeled tokens; objective is intrinsic confidence.
Steering vector adapted at test time from self-confidence; tiny sample-local update.
Layer-wise dynamic TTA where each layer is updated by its own NLL signal; no external supervision.
Teacher-forced gradient norm of the policy itself used as intrinsic GRPO reward.
Terminal hidden-state geometry replaces an external judge as the RL reward signal.
Visual self-supervised puzzles (jigsaw/rotation) generate the RL reward for a VLM.
Reverse-task likelihood serves as a prediction-statistic reward; Family-I/IV bridge marked with ^ddagger.
EMPO uses semantic-cluster mass over rollouts as the reward; B4 caveat: free-form variant uses external General-Verifier 1.5B SLM (math variant is clean).
Self-certainty (forward KL to uniform) over rollouts replaces external reward; intrinsic and label-free.
Path consistency plus volatility over rollouts as the reward; no external answer key.
Two co-evolving networks read each other's contrastive agreement as the reward, avoiding self-grading collapse.
EvoLMM closes a proposer-solver loop with multi-rollout consistency as the only reward signal (multimodal).
Majority vote over N test-time rollouts forms a pseudo-label that drives GRPO; canonical test-time RL.
Entropy-regularized majority-vote RL to balance exploration vs. consensus at test time.
Majority-vote reward shaped by entropy-based advantage; consensus is the gradient target.
Majority-vote reward with an entropy-band token mask selecting which tokens receive gradient.
Paraphrase-pair agreement between solver and reframer (same model) as the reward signal.
Soft frequency reward derived from rollout distribution; smoother than hard majority vote.
Fine-grained reward beyond majority vote, computed from multi-sample agreement statistics.
Composite path-and-answer self-scoring at training time; reward from multi-rollout structure.
Selective-complementary RL that detects spurious consensus and reweights gradients across rollouts.
Coevolutionary cross-population voting as the reward; B2/B4 caveat: heterogeneous LLMs, not strict same-lineage.
Offline iterative RL on majority-vote rewards; same recipe as TTRL but in train-time regime.
Majority reward plus semantic-novelty bonus to prevent entropy collapse under pure consensus.
TTRV ports majority-vote test-time RL to VLMs with a frequency-plus-entropy reward.
MM-UPT runs majority-vote RL on a VLM with self-generated multimodal prompts; train-time variant.
Anchor-explorer dual-voting escapes spurious-majority collapse; same-lineage two-head reward.
CSRS uses soft frequency over retraced multimodal reasoning sets to stabilize MLLM self-evolution.
Repeated VLM pairwise judgments aggregated into majority-voted rankings for image-quality self-evolution.
Self-Tuning generates document-grounded self-instructions and SFTs on them; no human seeds.
KBAlign aligns the model to a private KB via self-generated, KB-grounded instructions.
Two heads of one model alternately generate and verify instructions via cycle consistency; fully seed-free.
Self-consistency-filtered rationales become SFT targets; gradient is on kept generations, not the filter.
Quiet-STaR bootstraps latent rationales during CPT and SFTs on them with a per-token soft objective.
Confidence-selected reasoning traces become SFT targets; boundary-with-F4 noted.
Foresight-resampled trajectories become SFT targets; consensus is a selection mask, gradient is SFT.
Majority-vote-kept trajectories become SFT targets; gradient is on the synthetic target, not the vote.
Multi-agent debate trajectories become SFT targets; selection by debate consensus.
LongMagpie self-generates long-context instructions without an external selector; SFT on the synthesized pairs.
Long-context self-improvement: MBR-selected long rationales become SFT targets.
Test-time curriculum synthesis: SC-filtered curriculum becomes the SFT target on each test cohort.
Consensus-guided self-curriculum at test time; synthesized curriculum is the gradient target.
Test-time self-reflection generates a foresight curriculum and trains on it.
Challenger proposes problems at the Solver's boundary; Solver trains on majority-vote pseudo-labels of synthesized problems.
Self-consistency-ranked preference pairs feed DPO; preferences are the synthesized target.
Multi-agent collaborative debate produces preference pairs for DPO training.
Short-vs-long response pairs of the same prompt form a preference-pair target for long-context DPO.
P(True)-style confidence ranks rationales to form preference pairs for DPO; boundary-with-F4 noted.
G-Zero runs proposer-generator self-play with hint-driven preference pairs; open-ended generation.
QueST generates query-conditioned auxiliary problems at test time and trains a LoRA on them.
V-Zero trains a questioner-solver VLM loop on unlabeled images with majority-voted pseudo-labels.
Self-Rewarding LM alternates actor and judge roles; chosen/rejected pairs feed iterative DPO.
CREAM adds cross-iteration consistency regularization to counter bias amplification in the self-judge.
Meta-Rewarding elevates a meta-judge over judgments to counter judge saturation.
Temporal SRLM anchors chosen/rejected pairs to frozen-past or future-self models to fix gradient vanishing.
CoNL turns critique helpfulness into a Bradley-Terry-aggregated reward; structured multi-agent debate.
RLME uses the internal evaluator's natural-language meta-judgment as a scalar PG reward.
Meta-TTRL drives test-time RL with a metacognitive introspector as evaluator (multimodal).
AERO uses self-generated tasks and counterfactual critique for KTO-style updates; endogenous critique loop.
Same-lineage frozen judge modulates actor self-consistency; judge-gated reward.
Understanding-branch evaluator drives policy updates of the generation branch; Family-I/IV bridge marked ^ddagger.
